newsitem.title: USA: CME July lumber drops $10 limit on fund selling.
newsitem.headline: CME July lumber drops $10 limit on fund selling.

text.p: CME July lumber futures fell the $10.00 per tbf daily limit largely on fund selling and long liquidation, traders said.
The selling appeared to be a continuation from Friday's action in which lumber futures closed down the $10.00 limit in the July and August contracts.
Some traders said lower cash lumber prices last week contributed to Monday's pressure. Random Lengths on Friday quoted cash spruce at $358.00 per tbf versus $364.00 a week ago.
At 1055 CDT, lumber was off $10.00 to up $0.60 with July off the limit at $347.10.
